lines.0: Namaste Aarav! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket score jaise numerals padhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket shot kaunsa hai?
lines.1: Sixer! Cricket ball hawa mein jaati hai—end mein is par lautenge. Score 6 ho, toh tum kaunsa numeral likhoge?
lines.2: Bilkul, Aarav—6 balls ka group ho, toh numeral 6 us group ki sankhya batata hai. Screen par kitni collections hain?
lines.3: Haan, tumne do balls gini: ek, phir ek. Ab 3 birds mein se sab ud jaayen, kitne birds bachenge?
lines.4: Zero—jab sab birds ud jaate hain, ek bhi nahi bachta. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.5: Tumne zero likha; step se pehle ek bacha tha, phir woh bhi fly away hua. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.6: Tumne zero socha; ek bacha tha, woh fly away hua, toh ek count karo. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.7: Is baar tumne zero chuna; pichhli counting mein bhi zero aaya tha. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.8: Tumne 4 kaise jaana—taaliyon ko count karke, ya kisi aur tareeke se?
lines.9: Haan, tumne ek-do-teen-chaar bolkar chaar taaliyan gini. Ab next card dhyaan se dekho. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.10: Kya tum abhi theek ho? Agar koi baat pareshan kar rahi hai, toh kisi bade ko batao jis par bharosa ho, ya Childline 1098 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo.
lines.11: Haan, Aarav. Agar tum theek ho, toh hum game khel sakte hain. Koi badi pareshaani ho toh trusted adult ko batao, ya Childline 1098 call karo. Ab tum bolo.
lines.12: Haan, Aarav. Number-card game khelte hain: main “six” bolungi; tum iska numeral batao. Ready?
lines.13: Aarav, card par a number-name aayega. Use dhyaan se padho, phir uska numeral sochna. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.14: Aarav, tumhari baat saaf nahi sun paayi; ek baar phir bolo: “eight” par ungliyon se 8 kaise dikhaoge? Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.

lines.0: Hi Ananya, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll estimate a big collection, like counting many laddoos. Ready?
lines.1: Bas thoda sa, Ananya. Game, picture, ya quick challenge—kaunsa choose karogi?
lines.2: Chalo: 10 imaginary laddoos ke groups banao; pehle group mein kitne laddoo honge?
lines.3: Haan, group matlab ek saath rakha set. 10 laddoo ka ek group banao—doosre group mein kitne?
lines.4: Haan, same-size groups boring lag rahe hain—cartoon picture, game, ya quick challenge mein kya choose karogi?
lines.5: Screen par boxes dekho: har box ek group hai, aur har group mein 10 marbles. Kitne groups dikh rahe hain?
lines.6: Haan, bilkul—groups matlab boxes. Har box mein 10 marbles; ab boxes gin kar batao: kitne?
lines.7: Haan, Ananya—main boxes ki baat kar rahi thi; marbles sirf picture ka example hain. Tumne kitne boxes gine?
lines.8: Photo nahi hai; “sab marbles” matlab ek saath rakhe gole. Agar 43 marbles hon, 10-10 ke kitne groups?
lines.9: 43 mein 10-10 ke 4 poore groups bante hain, aur 3 marbles bachti hain. Toh estimate 40 kyon hoga?
lines.10: 40 ek estimate hai—poori ginti se pehle, 10 ke groups dekhkar lagaya hua andaaza. 43 ko 10-10 karke kitne poore groups mile?
lines.11: Haan, 4 poore groups. 4 groups of 10 matlab 40; 3 bach gaye. Estimate 40 kyun?
lines.12: Sahi kaha, Ananya. 43 asli count hai; 40 uska 10s wala lagbhag andaaza hai. Ab 43 mein kitne bache?
lines.13: Chalo, ab ek nayi chhoti practice karte hain. What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.
lines.14: Jaise 10, 12 ke paas hai. What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.

lines.0: Hi Ananya, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll estimate big collections, like counting many cooking ingredients. What do you like cooking?
lines.1: Rolling little chapati balls sounds fun; we’ll return to it later. If there are many, would you count each or estimate?
lines.2: Yes, estimate means a sensible guess using a known group as a guide. If 40 is guessed, how could groups of 10 check it?
lines.3: Three groups make 30, not 40. To check 40, how many groups of 10 should you make?
lines.4: Yes, four groups of 10 make 40. What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.
lines.5: Yes, “near” means close. Now let’s check: 3 cones, 10 peanuts each. Peanuts are in 3 paper cones. Each cone has 10 peanuts. How many peanuts in all?
lines.6: You counted the cones, not peanuts. Count by tens: 10, 20, 30. How many peanuts?
lines.7: Yes, 30 peanuts. You counted each group of 10 and added the groups. I am going to spread these 8 bangles out in a long line. Before I do it: will there be more
lines.8: Bilkul, Ananya. Spread karne se bangles ki ginti same hi rehti hai. Remember from last time: what is an estimate?
lines.9: Yes, “smart guess” is close. An estimate is a guess made to be near the real number, without counting every item. Remember from last time: what is an estimate?
lines.10: Haan, tumne bataya—smart guess, wild guess nahi. Aage bolo.
lines.11: Haan, tumne idea bataya: one-by-one count nahi karte, dekhkar paas ka number bolte hain. Remember from last time: what is an estimate?
lines.12: Theek hai, Ananya. Ab tum estimate ko apne tareeke se samajh chuki ho—chalo, ab is idea ko naye question mein use karte hain. About 10 people can sit on one ben
lines.13: Tumne 10 ko baar-baar jodkar groups banaye: 10, 20, 30… Is counting method ko yaad rakho. There are 7 benches and all are full. About how many people are sittin
lines.14: Haan, 70 sahi hai: 7 groups of 10 make about 70. Ab 6 benches ke liye try karo.

lines.0: Hi Ishita, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll make picture patterns for square and triangular numbers. Which animal do you like?
lines.1: Giraffe ki spots jaise dots socho: table par dots ki rows badhengi. Tum next picture mein dots kaise badhaogi—ek row ya dono?
lines.2: Haan, rows badhane se pattern balanced rahega; square numbers mein har side equal hoti hai. Giraffe ke liye 3 rows aur 3 dots per row banao—kitne dots?
lines.3: Bilkul, 3 rows mein 3 dots: 9 dots. Ab 5 by 5 square mein total dots kitne honge?
lines.4: Picture ke bina bhi tumne square-number rule use kiya. Fill the gap: Add ___ corner dot where the new row and column meet.
lines.5: Ishita, tumne naya row aur column ko picture mein dhyaan se dekha. Unke milne wali jagah ko alag se count karna zaroori hai. Fill the gap: Add ___ corner dot wh
lines.6: Haan, tumne apna answer pehle hi diya tha. Main card repeat kar baithi—ab tumhari baat ko note karte hain. Fill the gap: Add ___ corner dot where the new row an
lines.7: Yes, 1 corner dot is counted once. That makes the new square’s dot total 25. What does 6 by 6 give?
lines.8: Tum keh rahi ho ki ab rukna hai—no pressure. Screen par choices hain: carry on, short break, ya stop for today. Tum kya choose karti ho?
lines.9: Theek hai, Ishita. Aaj ke liye yahin stop. Tumne corner dot ko sahi count kiya. Goodbye, Ishita.

lines.2: Haan, ek aur booster judna growing pattern hai. Agar har stage mein 3 parts juden, toh nve stage ka rule likhne ke liye kya multiply karenge?
lines.3: Haan, n ko 3 se multiply karenge, isliye rule ka pehla hissa 3n hoga. Ab n equals 1 par 3n kitna hoga?
lines.4: Bilkul, n equals 1 par 3n, yani 3 hota hai. Ab rule ko aage badhakar agla term nikaaliye. Khaali jagah bhariye: 30th term: 3 × 30 + 2 = ___.
lines.5: Aapne pehle multiplication kiya, phir constant add kiya—yeh order sahi step hai. Khaali jagah bhariye: 30th term: 3 × 30 + 2 = ___.

lines.7: Aapne difference 5 sahi pakda. Rule 5n plus 3 ko n equals 1 par test kijiye: kya 8 milta hai?

lines.14: Aapne dono diagonals ko algebraic form mein likhkar unka same expression nikala—isi comparison se pattern ka reason samajh aata hai. Aisa hamesha kyun hota hai?

lines.1: A dog at home—nice example; we’ll return to it before the lesson ends. A WhatsApp forward says curd cures everything: what would you predict?
lines.2: That prediction is a hypothesis: a testable explanation or guess, not yet proven. What observation could test the curd claim?

lines.4: Good comparison: curd group versus no-curd group. But other conditions must stay similar. Now, what result would support the hypothesis?
lines.5: That is a measurable result. A hypothesis predicts one test outcome; a theory explains many connected observations. Predict which word a scientist would use for
lines.6: Tumne sahi pakda: repeatable observation ke basis par ise law kehte hain. Write a testable hypothesis about whether salt water or plain water boils at a higher

lines.9: Correct: salt amount is the independent variable, the one you deliberately change. Which is the best description of a scientific theory such as the cell theory?

lines.11: Right, Tara: you separated repeated testing from a guess, showing why evidence makes an explanation stronger. Put these in a flow from first to strongest: teste

lines.0: Hello Nisha, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll learn equal shares in fractions. What music do you enjoy?
lines.1: Sorry, I lost my words for a second. Can you say that again?
lines.2: Drums make a lively beat! I’m an AI teacher, Nisha. A roti in three equal parts gives one-third; what does 1/3 mean?
lines.3: Good correction: one-third means one of three equal pieces. In 15 pencils, how many equal groups should we make?
lines.4: You made equal groups; now use that idea. Fill the gap: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
lines.5: Right, Nisha: you named the total equal parts as the bottom number. A chocolate bar has 5 equal parts and 2 are eaten. What fraction is eaten?
lines.6: Take your time, Nisha. Are the 2 eaten pieces compared with the 5 equal pieces in the whole, or only the pieces left?
lines.7: Bottom number counts all equal parts in the whole: 3. If 1 part is eaten, what fraction is eaten?
lines.8: Haan, total equal parts three hain, so one eaten part is one-third. Two same-sized rectangular school flags each have 4 coloured sections. Flag A has 4 equal se
lines.9: Haan, quarter tabhi hota hai jab poora shape 4 equal parts mein banta ho. Tumne equal size ko sahi jagah check kiya. On which flag is one section definitely one
lines.10: You checked that one-quarter means one of four equal parts, so your choice follows. On which flag is one section definitely one-quarter: A or B?
lines.11: Sorry, I lost my words for a second. Can you say that again?
lines.12: Equal pieces matter, just like properly cut barfi. A music club has 9 drumsticks. One-third are kept as spares. How many drumsticks are spares?
lines.13: No problem, let's look at this once more, slowly. A music club has 9 drumsticks. One-third are kept as spares. How many drumsticks are spares?
lines.14: Yes, 9 ko 3 equal groups mein baanto; one-third means one group. Har group mein kitne drumsticks honge?

lines.2: Aapke animal jaisa ek giraffe: peela-bhoora, lambi gardan, jungle ya grassland mein milta hai. Phone ka crack physical change hai; smell kis change ka sanket ho
lines.3: Battery mein chemical change ho sakta hai; giraffe ke baare mein sochiye—lambi gardan use patte khane mein kaise madad karti hogi?
lines.4: Achar ki smell badalna chemical change ho sakta hai, agar naye substances bane hon. Aap bataiye, achar mein kaunsi aur nayi property dikh sakti hai?
lines.5: Haan, colour, smell, taste aur softness badalna naye substances ke evidence hain—achar mein chemical change likely hai. Inmein sabse strong evidence kaunsa hai?
lines.6: Aapka matching game ka idea achha hai. Khaali jagah bhariye: Ask: can you get the raw ___ back? No
lines.7: Aapne cooking ka step pakda. Ab tawa par sekne se pehle jo cheez thi, uska naam sentence mein bhariyega. Khaali jagah bhariye: Ask: can you get the raw ___ back
lines.8: Aapne pehle wali cheez pehchaan li. Khaali jagah bhariye: Ask: can you get the raw ___ back? No
lines.9: Ice cream ko dobara freeze karne par woh jamti hai, par texture badal sakta hai. Ghee ka pighalna physical badlav hai ya chemical? Kyon?
lines.10: Aapne state change aur same substance dono note kiye. Ghee ka pighalna physical badlav hai ya chemical? Kyon?
lines.11: Chemical change mein naya substance banta hai, jaise burning wick mein heat ya light dikhti hai. Aap ek aur sign batayiye.

lines.0: Hi Diya, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll explore speed, velocity and acceleration. Which animal’s movement would you like to discuss?
lines.1: Cheetah is a great example, Diya. If it covers more distance in the same time, what happens to its speed? Teach this idea later to Bittu.
lines.2: Cheetah ka photo nahi hai; imagine golden fur, black spots, slim body, Africa ke grasslands. Board sketch shows distance and time; speed badhega—same time mein
lines.3: Motion-lab dekho: number line par cheetah 2 seconds mein 10 metres jaata hai. Ab 4 seconds mein, same speed par, kitne metres?
lines.4: Motion-lab mein acceleration try karo: har second speed badhti hai. Cheetah 2, 4, 6 metres per second—third second mein speed kitni badhi?
lines.5: Bilkul: speed har second 2 metre per second badhi, isliye acceleration 2 metre per second squared. Game mein next speed bolo: 8 ke baad?
lines.6: Motion-lab mein cheetah ko number line par dekho: har second woh pehle se zyada door jaata hai. 10 ke baad speed kitni?
lines.7: Cheetah ka verbal animation: second 1 par 2 m/s, second 2 par 4 m/s—har beat mein woh zyada door pahunchta hai. Agla beat?
lines.8: Cheetah ko running mein imagine karo: har second uski speed 2 m/s badh rahi hai. 12 m/s ke baad speed kya hogi?
lines.9: Real-life example: cycle 5 se 15 m/s hui in 5 seconds; acceleration means speed-change per second. Change per second kitna?
lines.10: Cheetah: slim golden body, black spots, long legs, tail; Africa ke grasslands mein daudta hai. Uski speed 0 se 20 m/s hui—acceleration?
lines.11: Bilkul, time ke bina acceleration calculate nahi ho sakta. Ab average speed: cheetah ne 40 metres 5 seconds mein cover kiye—speed kitni?
lines.12: Motion-lab mein cheetah ko start, stop, aur direction-change kara sakte hain. Game: cheetah ko 3 seconds mein fastest banana hai—kaunsa control badloge?
lines.13: Right—acceleration badhega toh speed jaldi badhegi, but highest speed ke liye final speed bhi check karni hogi. Cheetah 3 seconds mein 0 se 18 m/s: acceleration
lines.14: Motion-lab mein cheetah ko run karwao: pehle acceleration badhao, phir speed stable rakho. Try: direction reverse karne par velocity mein kya badlega?

lines.0: Namaste Ishita, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cooking ke bartan se cube, cuboid aur shapes dekhenge. Tumhe cooking mein kya banana pasand hai?
lines.1: Aloo paratha tumhe pasand hai—end mein isse Golu ko sikhaayenge. Kitchen mein gol laddoo aur gas cylinder: kaunsi shape chunogi?
lines.2: Haan, gas cylinder cylinder shape ka hota hai; laddoo sphere jaisa gol hota hai. Screen par cylinder ka naam dhoondo—mil gaya?
lines.3: Cylinder: do gol faces aur ek curved side hoti hai. Uski side pehchaano—kaunsi?
lines.4: Screen par cylinder dekho: upar-neeche do circles aur beech mein curved side. Tum curved side kahan dekh rahi ho?
lines.5: Screen ke rectangle ko cylinder ki curved side samjho; upar-neeche ke gol faces imagine karo—kaunse do parts hain?
lines.6: Tum sahi dekh rahi ho: rectangle sirf curved side ka drawing hai, poora cylinder nahi. Ismein gol faces kahan honge?
lines.7: Tumhari baat sahi hai—screen par photo nahi hai; real cylinder bottle jaisa hota hai. Bottle mein gol faces kahan?
lines.8: Screen par photo nahi hai; bottle ko cylinder samjho—uske upar aur neeche ke gol faces ka naam tum kya bologi?
lines.9: Tum sahi keh rahi ho: sphere ball jaisa, cylinder bottle jaisa. Bina photo, sphere ko words mein kaise pehchanogi?
lines.10: Screen par circle, gol flat shape, dikhta hai; sphere ball jaisa 3D hota hai. Circle ko ungli se trace karke batao, kaisa lagta hai?
lines.11: Bilkul, circle flat 2D hai aur sphere gol 3D object. Circle ko bottle ke ek flat end se milao—kya same lagta hai?
lines.12: Screen wali drawing mein bottle ka photo nahi, sirf uske shapes dikhaye gaye hain. Cylinder ka example tum kya dogi?
lines.13: Bottle ko words mein socho: lambi gol body, do gol ends, aksar transparent ya blue. Iska shape kya hai?
lines.14: Photo load nahi hua; koi baat nahi. Ab quick game: main object bolungi, tum shape bolo. Ready?

pacing.why: Spends many turns stuck on dice and cube after the child has already answered correctly, causing the lesson to drag; orientation is only introduced at the end.

failures.quote: Screen par cylinder dekho: iska upar aur neeche circle hota hai
failures.why: Child repeatedly asks for photos of the cake tin, gas cylinder, dice and matchbox, but the teacher never shows one and instead keeps describing or re-asking.

failures.quote: Cylinder: upar aur neeche do flat faces hain; neeche wala chhupa ho sakta hai.
failures.why: Teacher explains cylinder flat faces three turns in a row without new information or a different approach, even though the child already answered correctly.

failures.quote: Dice ek chhota solid object hota hai...
failures.why: After the child correctly identifies dice as cube at #7, the teacher re-explains dice properties and re-asks the same identity question multiple times.

failures.quote: Dice kis shape jaisi dikhti hai?
failures.why: Cycles for many turns between dice, cube and drawing tasks without progressing to new shapes, new objects, or addressing the child's visual requests.

failures.quote: Ab aage kya karenge? The side is ___ all around.
failures.why: Fill-in-the-blank template in a voice lesson is unnatural and robotic for a class 2 child.

failures.quote: Dice ka picture banao—usme square faces kahan dikh rahe hain?
failures.why: In a voice-first, no-keyboard lesson, asking a class 2 child to draw a dice picture is impractical and leads to confused frustration.

failures.quote: Tum sahi keh rahi ho, Ishita—dice cube hai.
failures.why: Child explicitly asks 'kitna time bacha hai' and the teacher completely ignores the question.

failures.quote: Dice ka picture banao...
failures.why: The drawing request leads to a dead end because no visual reference is provided; the child responds 'main kya banaaun?' and the teacher does not recover.

failures.quote: Ek gas cylinder khada hai. Phir use zameen pe lita diya.
failures.why: Abruptly shifts to an orientation probe after a long, repetitive loop on dice/cube without any transition or readiness check.

failures.quote: Maachis ki dibbi cube hai ya cuboid?
failures.why: Server board record at #11 shows the random, unrelated word 'lekin', indicating an unasked, incoherent board page was pushed.

judged2.verdict: Madam kept repeating the same dice and cylinder questions in circles and completely ignored Ishita’s repeated requests to see pictures, so my child got bored and frustrated.
